0.heading: Overview
refs: Acts 12:1 , King Herod persecutes the Christians, kills James, and imprisons Peter
whom an angel delivers upon the prayers of the church
Acts 12:20 , Herod in his pride taking to himself the honour due to God, is stricken by an angel, and dies miserably
Acts 12:24 , After his death, the word of God prospers
Acts 12:25 , Saul and Barnabas return to Antioch.
